name: Snf2 related CREBBP activator protein

function.text: SRCAP encodes chromatin remodeling protein SRCAP. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. It participates in cAMP/PKA signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Floating-Harbor syndrome (autosomal dominant); developmental delay, hypotonia, musculoskeletal defects, and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
